query: If measurement invariance fails, what analytic strategies (partial invariance, anchor items, item removal, or group-specific scoring) best preserve valid mediation analyses?

response.query: If measurement invariance fails, what analytic strategies (partial invariance, anchor items, item removal, or group-specific scoring) best preserve valid mediation analyses?
response.answer: When measurement invariance fails, partial invariance and anchor items help preserve valid mediation analyses. Item removal and group-specific scoring are also viable strategies.
